description: On the table there’s a white square base with upright pegs and a separate white rectangular block lying in front of it. The right hand moves in from the right to pick up the block as a right-hand object, carries it forward and slightly left over the base, and presses it down onto a peg to seat it, while the left hand stays nearby and then lightly steadies the base; the right hand releases and withdraws, leaving the block attached.
